profile.headline: Co-founder, Haruhana USA | Premium Mounted Staghorns | Software Engineer @ Yelp

positions.title: Software Engineer - Core Infrastructure
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain internal tools and applications that powers our infrastructure
- Built and maintained a search platform using a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) framework, retrieving context from internal knowledge sources and piping it into LLMs for accurate, grounded responses
- Designed and built agentic workflows to automate infrastructure tasks and streamline business operations using specialized LLM agents
- Designed and implemented a multi-agent framework with specialized LLM agents to reduce errors, streamline logic, and simplify complex workflows

positions.title: Application Engineer - Corporate Infrastructure
positions.description:
• Manage, administer and secure org-wide cloud applications such as Google Workplace / Cloud, Jira, Confluence, Slack, Okta, PagerDuty, LastPass, etc. 
• Leverage API's (Google, LDAP, Okta, Slack, Jira) and develop scripts and services to automate workflows and improve processes between our systems. 
• Create and maintain clear and concise technical documentation. 
• Provide On Call / On Point assistance with escalations and custom technical requests.

positions.title: IT Support - Helpdesk Technician
positions.description:
Troubleshoot and provide support for enterprise level applications, hardware, software, network, telecommunications and A/V equipment.  
Proactively designed and developed internal micro-services using Python, Flask, JavaScript, and SQL to relieve workflow pain points and bottlenecks for internal Yelpers.

positions.title: IT Logistics Technician
positions.description: Point of contact for imaging, provisioning, deployment and desk setups of laptops and desktops for new hires and current employees. Decommissioning of assets and performing minor repairs. Performed inventory management, cycle audit counts and managed life cycle hardware policies. Highly dependable in a shorthanded team which required learning the systems quickly and to hit the ground running in a very short amount of time.

positions.title: IT Technician / Sales
positions.description:
Onsite and Remote Network / System Administration and Help Desk Support
Sales Quoting, Procurement, Vendor Management, Licensing Management and Ordering
Worked with: HP ProLiant Servers, Dell, Lenovo, HP, HPE, Macbooks, APC UPS, Cisco Meraki, SonicWall, VMware, Parallels, Proofpoint, TrendMicro, Windows 7/10/Server 2016, MacOS, iOS and Linux
Experienced with ConnectWise support ticketing system and QuoteWerks quoting system. 
Acquired Certifications: Intermedia Advisor, CompTIA A+, AWS Associate Solutions Architect

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Offering IT / Telecom help desk maintenance / support with superior and unmatched customer follow up and service.

positions.title: Business Acct Executive / Construction Management
positions.description: Developing relationships with small to medium size businesses and the community, to position the Comcast brand as key components of the sales strategy. Using consultative selling approach to understand business needs and deliver face to face effective presentations to recommend optimal solutions. Heavy utilization of Salesforce, social media resources and database tools to generate leads, close prospects, and deliver superior customer service.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
TiuTick.com is an online and mobile platform for members to rate, recommend and review services in Hong Kong. Our platform also provides a conduit for direct interaction between business owners and customers in Hong Kong.

TiuTick means to be picky in Cantonese. We like to call our members "smart consumers"
From shopping, personal services, to entertainment and nightlife, Tiutick.com offers the easiest and fastest way to find quality services in Hong Kong.

*** Update ***
Our database has been merged by localiiz. Thank you for all your support!
For a more updated directory please visit http://www.localiiz.com
